documents.name: Academic Transcripts
documents.description: Official transcripts from all previously attended educational institutions.

documents.name: English Language Certificate
documents.description: IELTS, TOEFL, or equivalent English proficiency test results.

documents.name: Motivation Letter
documents.description: A personal statement explaining your motivation to study in the Netherlands.

documents.name: University Offer Letter
documents.description: Official conditional or unconditional offer from your Dutch university.

documents.name: Programme Information
documents.description: Details about your chosen Bachelor programme including curriculum.

documents.name: Tuition Fee Payment Proof
documents.description: Bank receipt or confirmation showing full tuition fee payment.

documents.name: Block Money Evidence
documents.description: Bank statement showing sufficient funds (approximately €2,700 or as required by IND).

documents.name: Health Insurance Certificate
documents.description: Valid Dutch or internationally accepted health insurance.

documents.name: Housing Confirmation
documents.description: Proof of accommodation arrangement in the Netherlands.

documents.name: Valid Passport
documents.description: Passport with at least 6 months validity beyond your intended stay.

documents.name: Passport Photos
documents.description: Recent biometric passport photographs meeting Dutch visa requirements.

documents.name: MVV Application Form
documents.description: Completed Machtiging tot Voorlopig Verblijf application form.

documents.name: IND Approval Letter
documents.description: Approval letter from IND confirming your residence permit application.

documents.name: Flight Booking
documents.description: Confirmed return or onward flight booking to the Netherlands.

documents.name: Travel Insurance
documents.description: Comprehensive travel insurance for the journey.
